content: pkgdown 2.2.1 (CRAN, 2026-07-07): imports bslib >= 0.5.1, ragg, rmarkdown >= 2.27. Requires pandoc >= 2.10.1. Logo workflow: place logo.svg (preferred) or logo.png at man/figures/logo.png; pkgdown auto-discovers it. usethis::use_logo() places logo and generates README markdown. build_favicons() sends logo to realfavicongenerator.net API (network required, one-time), stores results in pkgdown/favicon/, copied by init_site(). Extra CSS: pkgdown/extra.css copied and linked in <head>; pkgdown/extra.scss compiled into main CSS (preferred). Template bslib theming: template.bslib with bg, fg, primary, base_font, heading_font, code_font. brand.yml: template.bslib.brand: _brand.yml supports colors, fonts, logos fields; requires bslib 0.12.0. Bootswatch themes available via template.bootswatch. navbar.bg and navbar.type control navbar colors. light-switch option for dark mode.
